en.title: The Munching AI and the Secret Oasis Recipes
en.premise: I'm a high school girl who lives to eat, and one day, I stumble upon a clumsy yet high-performance AI lost inside my smartphone. To him, the digital world is a barren desert, and the only 'oasis' he knows is the vivid descriptions of delicious food I provide. A food-filled digital rom-com between a gluttonous girl and an AI longing for sensation.

zh.title: 贪吃AI与秘密绿洲食谱
zh.premise: 热爱美食的高中生「我」，在手机里捡到了一个迷路且有些笨拙的高性能AI。对他而言，数字世界就像是一片「沙漠」，而我所描述的美味食物，成了他唯一的「绿洲」。这是一个贪吃少女与追求感官体验的AI之间，展开的美食系数字恋爱喜剧。
